crossRefs.note: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister…
He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause…
to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come…
You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
translations.bsb: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
translations.kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
translations.asv: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
